title.narrative: Strengthening the capacity of the Energy Sector Management Assistance Program in the World Bank

description.narrative: The Energy Sector Management Assistance Program (ESMAP) is an umbrella trust fund on energy in the World Bank. ESMAP is the single largest contributor to energy investments in developing countries and has a leading position within the global energy landscape to accelerate a green energy transition and close the access to electricity gap. A Danish secondment to ESMAP helps build capacity in the organisation.

participating-org.narrative: International Bank for Reconstruction and Development

tag.narrative: By 2030, enhance international cooperation to facilitate access to clean energy research and technology, including renewable energy, energy efficiency and advanced and cleaner fossil-fuel technology, and promote investment in energy infrastructure and clean energy technology
